name: claude-code-status-bar
description: Configurable status bar for Claude Code: usage limits, context window, git state, live activity, pacing markers, and 8 colour themes.

plugins.name: claude-code-status-bar
plugins.description: Warns you before a rate limit or auto-compact, not after. A pure-bash Claude Code status bar (no jq, Node optional) for macOS, Linux, and Windows: usage pacing + burn-rate forecast, context warnings, live activity, cost, git, and 8 themes.

plugins.name: pacing-mod
plugins.description: Usage pacing pane for the Claude Code Desktop app and VS Code, where the status line does not run: 5-hour and weekly limits with an even-pace marker and burn-rate forecast, in the status bar's 8 themes.
